summary: Champion update: new W Essence Flux detonating orb; Q AP ratio lowered; E prioritizes W-marked targets.
R Spirit Rush cooldown increased at early ranks to limit lane snowballing.
Empowered E damage reduced early; R damage and execute damage reduced.
Base AD reduced 66 to 63 to curb early-game dominance.
Hail of Blades bugfix: first attack no longer benefits; notes call it a substantial power-down.
W Ebb and Flow heal reduced at all ranks; damage unchanged.
Base health regen reduced 9 to 7.5.
Passive no longer deals less damage than intended with Tiamat passive.
E passive no longer deals reduced damage when proc'd by Stormrazor crit.
Leaving Tahm Kench belly into R wall no longer causes extended loss of control.
Base health reduced 613 to 573 to punish greedy dives.
Passive slow increased (crit multiplier lowered); E Hawkshot now pings spotted enemies.
Base health cut 562 to 510; health regen raised slightly.
Q Spinning Axe fixes: crits on switched attacks, axe no longer lost on cancel.
New W Essence Flux base damage increased at later ranks; movement-cancel bugfix.
Base movement speed reduced 340 to 335.
Movement speed, early W on-hit damage, and E shield increased.
Passive AP scaling on missing-health proc cut; R shield duration 3s to 2s.
W root duration increased at early ranks (1s to 1.4s at rank 1).
W cooldown and cost reduced; R cost reduced to 100 at all ranks.
Abilities recoded; fixes to passive, Q vs spell shields, W snowball collision, R damage.
Q Stretching Strikes base damage increased substantially for clear and Q-second builds.
Q damage increased late; E cooldown reduced late; rewards landed skillshots.
Boots of Swiftness now properly reduce Q Bone Skewer self-slow.
Plants no longer try to target units without health bars.
Mid-patch fix: Mistwalkers no longer deal less damage than intended.
Last-hit assistance removed; W cooldown up early; R damage down early, up late.
Q Lunge now prioritizes R-affected targets even without an active Vital.
Four passive haste fixes, including correcting the 8.20 Hail of Blades fix.
W Distortion base damage reduced by 10; preseason expected to nerf her indirectly.
E Sapling Toss cooldown reduced and early damage increased, aiding jungle clear.
Base AD increased; Q heal vs champions increased after last patch QoL changes fell short.
Grey health, W speed, E stun, R execute rescaled to AD/lethality; mana costs reduced.
Q Chomp base damage and AD ratio increased, returning dueling power nerfed earlier.
Q discharge and R base damage shifted into higher AP ratios.
No longer stops moving after casting W Electrical Surge.
E Stacked Deck no longer breaks when empowered attack hits a Teemo shroom.
R duration 12s to 10s; revive heal now maxes at 80% Blood Well.
W base damage and rank-scaling AP ratio up; R no falloff but weaker vs minions.
New passive Iceborn Subjugation; mana costs lowered; W damage and R ratio reduced.
Q cooldown and cost down; multi-hit penalty on all units; Worked Ground shortened.
Pets now draw minion and turret aggro onto Yorick when damaging champions.
Mid-patch fix: attack speed was higher than intended.
Mid-patch fix: R Cannon Barrage no longer always deals rank 1 damage.
Mid-patch fix of overcorrected aggro fix: pets no longer draw minion aggro onto Yorick.
Mid-patch fix: passive on-hit damage now scales properly with Plasma stacks.
Q no longer deals bonus damage to monsters, removing smite-assisted mid lane strength.
W Twilight Shroud duration and max extension reduced.
Base attack speed reduced to slow jungle clear.
Coordinated-play R damage reduction and center knockup removed; Q and E brawling power increased.
Rescript fixes lean to buffs: turret beam scales with CDR; upgraded W damage slightly up.
E cooldown reduced early; R cooldown reduced late to match top lane fighters.
W cooldown up early, damage reduction 50% to 40%, no Fervor stack on cast.
R third-attack on-hit damage reduced at ranks 2 and 3.
W cooldown increased early to offset preseason Dark Harvest buff.
Q base damage/cooldown nerfed (top harass); E ratio/cooldown buffed (mid mage).
Q and W now fire toward target position when Flash is used mid-cast.
W Void Seeker now fires toward target position when Flash is used mid-cast.
Recall-cancelled W+Q combo no longer stuns without displacing the target.
Basic attack no longer cancels if Double Strike stack counter expires mid-attack.
Allies can no longer detonate W Blighted Quiver stacks.
Mid-patch fixes for grenade stuns, extra turret charge, rocket cooldown bugs introduced this patch.
Shroud now briefly obscures before stealth, targeted spells complete; 8.24 duration nerf reverted.
MR growth, Q secondary minion damage, and late R execute threshold cut to hit mid Pyke.
Q base damage up, passthrough down; R range 3500 at all ranks.
R Missile Barrage base damage increased.
Base health increased; E Fling damage increased early.
E Explosive Charge base damage and bonus AD ratio increased.
W missing-health damage increased late; R base damage increased early.
Base AD increased 63 to 65.
E Trample damage and empowered attack damage reduced early.
Q cost up and damage down at late ranks due to Q-max dominance.
Base health regen reduced 8 to 6.
Q initial and bounce damage slightly reduced.
Base armor and armor growth reduced; 9.19 range kept but too strong.
Villain removed, R always true damage; passive, W shield, E spins scale with attack speed.
Now ranged (475 range); W no longer increases range.
Passive and W AP ratios and base armor up, avoiding her pro-leaning power.
Q base damage reduced at later ranks; targets higher-skill games; Dark Passage bugfix.
Q base damage reduced at early ranks.
W boxes AoE; more early, less late damage; E magic damage; AD/AP builds diverge.
Base AD 59 to 61; mana regen and other stats rounded up.
Q shield not mana-based; new W augment slow; R ticks faster, chases over terrain.
No longer loses turret aggro permanently after ally dies while she is in stasis.
R Featherstorm no longer loses rotation lock when cast directly below Xayah.
E Snowball Barrage can no longer slow an enemy more than once per cast.
R Cyclone no longer breaks when Vi Q kills Wukong during cast.
R cooldown now refreshes on Q explosion-edge hits; Q explosion hidden in fog.
Winter Wonder Neeko no longer loses base stats when polymorphed by Lulu during R.
Lulu W on transforming Mega Gnar no longer grants extra buffs.
Passive Illumination now properly tagged as single-target ability.
Hotfix: disguised Neeko temporarily could not self-select to drop disguise (restored in 9.21).
Hotfix: augmented Q Turbocharge now properly increases shield strength.
E base damage per spin reduced by 4 after 9.20 changes; ratios unchanged.
Q damage and Rhaast ratio increased; bonus monster damage reduced.
Q and E base damage increased; mana stats rounded up.
E Help, Pix! shield and damage increased at later ranks.
W cost flattened, damage up; R root duration up; Q bugfix.
Guinsoo Phantom Hits now properly proc and stack Double Strike.
Health growth reduced; passive grey health from damage reduced to 25-50%.
W box duration 60s to 40s after strong 9.20 landing.
Passive stacks no longer fail after empowered attack; resource bar shows aura color.
Q damage +10 and base stats rounded up after weaker-than-expected 9.20 changes.
Q max-health ratio increased later; W bonus attack speed increased early.
Wolf now attacks enemies in range during W when Kindred is not attacking.
Hijacked Nidalee cougar Q Takedown now deals damage.
Neeko can again select herself to cancel disguise (2s cooldown).
No longer loses untargetability when dismounting near turrets or walls.
W Volley mana cost 50 to 70 to curb early harass.
Q Rocket Grab base damage reduced; still too strong after recent changes.
Q Rootcaller dash fixes (live since 9.21): melee range landing, camps, ally teleport.
Q non-minion multi-hit missile damage 30% to 25%.
W Sentinel mark max-health damage and mark duration increased.
Q base damage reduced; W cost increased to weaken laning.
R AP ratio 1.0 to 0.8, targeting AP Malphite.
R primary target base damage reduced by 50.
Q minion reduction up, execute threshold down; W boots dash speed removed; targets high-rank games.
Base AD, regen and attack speed growth up; Q damage and ratio up; E bugfix.
Base regen and MR up, W cost down after pro-vs-solo changes lowered his power.
W bonus attack speed reduced to curb hypercarry DPS.
No longer takes damage when target dies before Energized headshot lands.
Second R activation now properly knocks up nearby enemies.
E barrels no longer trigger Teemo R shrooms.
Q Urchin Strike now properly breaks spell shields.
Interrupted R Destiny no longer blocks projectiles.
R cooldown now correct if Taric dies during the cast window.
R Void Rush refund now consistent when champion dies during cast.
Q Takedown empowered attacks now damage traps.
Out-of-range R now casts immediately instead of walking into range.
Basic attacks on structures now reduce Q cooldown.
Passive no longer converts Spellthief's Edge AP to adaptive force (ARAM part excluded).
E stun no longer removes a second stun applied during it.
W crit no longer hits through Teemo blind.
Q cancelled by vision loss no longer locks out E.
W empowered attack window no longer lasts indefinitely after cancel.
Auto-attack after R dash now grants a Conqueror stack.
Dragon Form Q now grants multiple Conqueror stacks.
Mid-patch: base health, mana, mana regen and Q damage up after early preseason data.
Pro-facing: Q rear hitbox removed, rank 5 minion/monster damage reduced.
Q cooldown reduced at early ranks given post-preseason state.
Health, regen, W, R buffed; leans into anti-ranged role without making him pro default.
Gameplay update: E/R swapped, passive attack speed, new AoE pull ultimate Moonfall.
E spins per attack speed and level damage reduced after Conqueror changes.
E Inspire base shield increased for supportive builds.
Q cooldown increased early; W mana restore reduced late.
Health growth increased; E cooldown now scales down with rank.
Q Overload base damage reduced by 15 to cut early damage and waveclear.
Health growth, soul drops, Q damage, W root cut; R ratio up; hits ADC Senna most.
Base AD 61 to 63.
Enchanter rework: passive mana, stronger E heal/attack speed, weaker Q, no Anchor teleport.
E Toxic Shot now properly procs Dark Harvest.
R clones killing drakes no longer disrupt souls, drake types, or Elder spawn.
Q handle hits on spell-shielded enemies no longer heal Darius.
Mid-patch: W no longer goes on cooldown when Blast Plant knocks her off; bar fix.
Mid-patch: Calibrum mark ratio cut, on-hit bug fixed; Infernum R ratio and radius reduced.
Mid-patch: attacks after E Lunar Rush now grant correct Conqueror stacks.
